title: Brand mark · Standard print positioning
slide_intent: Show how equal insets and reading direction determine a dependable corner for identification. A mark near a binding can be harder to see.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can establish a familiar page position while accommodating books that open in different directions.
demonstration: An enlarged corner detail uses equal X dimensions. Miniature documents show top- and bottom-right placements for left-to-right scripts and a left-side placement for right-to-left scripts.
practical_value: Determine the script direction and binding edge, then inset the mark equally from the two outer edges of its corner.

content_islands.name: Positioning instructions
content_islands.spec: Set standard placement and the right-to-left exception in separate paragraphs at left.

content_islands.name: Inset detail
content_islands.spec: Magnify one corner in a circle. Mark the horizontal and vertical offsets with the same X.

content_islands.name: Document layouts
content_islands.spec: Place the two standard placements beneath the detail. Use a tinted example for the reversed reading direction and keep its note adjacent.
